record.description: A grey insulated lunch tote with a double-deck layout that keeps foods separated so they do not get crushed. Its thick PEVA liner wipes clean and resists leaks, and the insulated lining helps keep items cold or warm. Suits lunches, snacks, drinks, picnics, and everyday carrying.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line. Suitable for oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher use. Each piece is handcrafted by skilled artisans and made in England, making it a practical addition to everyday dining.

specs.shape: Chaise, scratch block and floor lounger

record.description: A cardboard cat scratcher shaped as a chaise that doubles as a lounging spot. Catnip is layered between the corrugate sheets so its scent releases with each scratch. The texture mimics tree bark, which many cats prefer for scratching. Made in the USA.
A sleeveless midi dress in navy lace with a fitted bodice and flared skirt. Partially lined for added comfort. The contemporary cut runs small, so consider sizing up.

A cherry blossom scented bath and shower gel that gently cleanses the skin, leaving it delicately perfumed. Work it into a lather on wet skin, then rinse away for a fragrant shower. Suited to sensitive skin.
An oil filter from the WIX brand, model 57502XP, made in China. Its package measures about 3.1 by 3.1 by 5.1 inches and weighs 0.75 pounds, making it a compact unit for engine oil filtration.

A large outdoor blanket for beach, picnic, camping, or hiking trips, sized to seat four to eight adults. Made from nylon that resists sand and water and dries quickly. Four built-in pockets hold small items, and four stakes help keep it anchored in wind. Folds small and weighs about 12 ounces for easy carrying.
A versatile kids' boat shoe that works as both a sneaker and a dress shoe. It has a leather-like upper, a lace-up closure for a secure fit, and a cushioned memory foam footbed for all-day comfort.

Women's classic short fashion boot from UGG in black. Features a soft suede upper, a UGGpure lining and insole for a plush feel, and a Treadlite outsole. A rubber UGG logo print sits on the front of the shaft.

specs.dimensions: 12 in neck width, 22 in bottom width, 29 in height

record.description: A glossy, smooth-surfaced waterproof apron in pink, built to resist stains and wipe clean easily. It is lightweight for long shifts and suits cooking, food prep, gardening, and garage work. Adjustable matching straps and long waist ties help it fit comfortably.

A full motion wall mount bracket for most flat and curved TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches. It supports up to 33 lbs and offers tilt, swivel, and 360-degree rotation. A three-arm steel design extends up to 14 inches and collapses close to the wall. Mounting hardware for wood studs, concrete, and brick is included.

specs.dimensions: About 40 in height; shelf 11 in radius, 0.7 in thickness

record.description: A three-tier fan-shaped corner shelf made of lightweight paulownia wood with a torched dark brown finish and jute rope for hanging. Suited to corners in living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, or bathrooms, it holds small decor, plants, or photo frames. Hang it from a nail, screw, or hook and adjust the rope so the shelves sit level.

A soft, comfortable set of coordinating dresses for baby girls, made from 100% cotton. The blueberry print suits everyday wear, and the gentle fabric is kind to delicate skin. Sized for 12 to 18 months.

specs.features: Odor control with Febreze freshness
specs.absorption: Rapid-drying top layer with Wet-Lock Gel

record.description: Disposable training pads for dogs that absorb quickly and use a rapid-drying top layer to help prevent tracking. A built-in attractant draws dogs to the pad, and the formula helps neutralize ammonia odors.

specs.material: ABS plastic mount, stainless steel rod

record.description: A collapsible wall-mounted drying rack that folds flat when not in use and opens to provide a hanging rail for air-drying or reducing wrinkles. Suited to laundry rooms, closets, and bedrooms, it installs on drywall, brick, concrete, or wood with included hardware.

Yellow mesh nylon banner with black OVERSIZE LOAD lettering for marking wide or heavy loads on vehicles. Brass grommets allow quick attachment to the front or back of a vehicle. Black edge binding helps reduce fraying. Intended for hauling large equipment, boats, or modular homes.

Floating practice golf balls for water-based training in pools, ponds, and water ranges, and for fun in the water. Each two-piece ball has 432 dimples and a molded Surlyn cover. A carry bag is included for transport and storage.

specs.connection: Universal faucet adapter with quick connect

record.description: A compact countertop dishwasher suited to apartments, offices, and small kitchens. It offers six wash cycles, a delay start of two to eight hours, and a stainless steel interior with a six place setting rack. An LED display shows remaining time or the current running state.

specs.product type: DIY cake pop maker toy kit
specs.included: Bain-marie, decorating stands, baking gadgets, recipes booklet

record.description: A kids' kitchen toy kit for making cake pops at home without an oven. It comes with a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking and decorating tools, plus a color-printed recipe booklet. Food ingredients are not included, and the kit is intended for children aged 6 and up.

specs.fit: Most round kitchen and bathroom faucets

record.description: A swivel faucet aerator that rotates a full 720 degrees so water can reach every part of a sink. It has three flow settings, from a gentle stream for hands and face to a stronger spray for rinsing produce. Made of solid brass with a bright finish, it installs by hand and aims to reduce splashing.

specs.midsole: Bounce with Boost in the heel
specs.recycled content: Upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content

record.description: Men's golf shoes from adidas in grey, green, and black with a regular fit and lace closure. The mesh and synthetic upper is made partly from recycled materials, and the Bounce midsole with a Boost heel adds cushioning for the course.
A men's straw hat in an Outback style, featuring a vented crown for airflow. Finished in a natural tone, this extra-large hat suits warm-weather days outdoors.

specs.use: Bathroom vanity storage for cotton swabs, cotton balls, and bath salts

record.description: A two-piece clear canister set with 15 oz and 20 oz jars for organizing bathroom vanity items such as cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, and bath salts. Each jar has a removable lid and a wide mouth for easy access. Made of plastic that resembles glass without shattering, it also suits kitchen or living room shelves.

specs.material: Hybrid dual layer: rubberized interior, hardened external cover
specs.included: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector
specs.features: Card holder slot, kickstand, swivel belt clip

record.description: A protective cover for the Samsung Galaxy On5 phone, with a brushed metal texture finish. The two-layer design pairs a rubberized inner layer with a hard outer shell to help absorb shocks. Includes a tempered glass screen protector, a card slot, and a kickstand for viewing. Phone not included.

specs.use areas: Upper and lower lips, cheeks, chin

record.description: A compact electric facial hair remover for women that uses dual stainless steel blades to trim fine and coarse facial hair at home or while traveling. It is designed as a shaver rather than an epilator and is marketed as gentle on all skin types. One replacement head comes in the box.

A double-layer camping hammock sized for two large adults, made from seamless 210T nylon with black and orange faces you can alternate. Includes two long webbing tree straps with adjustable loops and two carabiner clips. Folds into an attached carry bag that can hang from a backpack, suited to camping, hiking and travel.
A hooded reindeer costume made for dogs, suited to Christmas or any winter-themed party. Velcro straps at the neck and chest hold it closed. Available in a medium size.

A height-adjustable desk for sitting or standing work, with a wooden 47 by 30 inch top on a metal frame rated for 165 lbs. Dual motors raise and lower the top between 29 and 49 inches, and the top tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. A touch control panel includes memory presets, a child lock, and two USB charging ports.

specs.contents: 5 pirates, 2-piece cannon, treasure chest, eye patch, flag

record.description: A ten-piece pirate-themed playset with five pirate figures, a two-part cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. Suited to imaginative play, school projects, dioramas, party favors, and cake toppers. Made without phthalates or lead and simple to wipe clean with soap and water. Recommended for ages 3 and up.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot
specs.fit: Trim-to-fit, for casual and athletic shoes

record.description: Trim-to-fit performance insoles for men's shoes, sized for Men's 9-10.5. A contoured neutral arch suits most foot types, and gel pads in the heel and forefoot add light cushioning. A moisture-wicking treatment helps keep feet dry. Designed for casual and athletic footwear used for walking, running, or cross training.

specs.material: Polyester fabric upholstery, dark walnut stained wood legs

record.description: A mid-century modern accent armchair with a curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline. Upholstered in soft polyester with subtle piped trim, it rests on dark walnut-stained wood legs with non-marking caps. Dense foam padding gives a supportive seat for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or entryways.

Two-tier round stainless steel lunch container with a vacuum-tight seal to help prevent leaks and spills. Locking clips hold the tiers together. BPA free and safe for dishwasher and freezer use, suitable for soup and hot food.

Women's knit Bermuda pajama shorts with a comfortable elastic waistband and relaxed fit. Features a printed design created by the HUE NYC studio team, offering a colorful, one-of-a-kind look for sleepwear.

specs.included: Extra hands, head, wing backpack, holographic wings, 2 weapons

record.description: A fully articulated 6-inch collectible action figure of Falcon from the Avengers: Infinity War film, made by Bandai's S.H.Figuarts line. Comes with alternate hands, a head, a backpack for wings, holographic wings, and weapons, and can be posed in a flying configuration using detachable wing parts.
A red radiator grille decal sticker designed to fit the front grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger. It uses adhesive double-sided tape for simple installation directly on the car. Sold as one set.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from the Avengers Endgame film, made by Funko in its signature Pop! design. Standing about 3.75 inches tall, it suits display alongside other figures from the same film.

specs.character theme: My Hero Academia (Izuku, Froppy/Tsuyu Asui, Ochaco Uraraka)
specs.intended use: Cosplay, Halloween, theme parties, daily wear

record.description: Cosplay sweatpants inspired by the My Hero Academia anime, styled as training pants. Made from cotton and sized to US standards, they suit costume wear, themed parties, Halloween, or casual everyday use. A playful gift for anime fans.

specs.frame: Rust-free powder coated steel with 8 ribs
specs.features: Crank lift, push-button tilt, air vent

record.description: A 9-foot outdoor market umbrella offering shade for a table with four to six chairs. The polyester canopy is water-resistant and fade resistant, and a crank lift opens and closes it. Push-button tilt adjusts the angle without moving the base, and a wind vent helps air flow. Base not included.

specs.included_seeds: Zinnia, Marigold, Cosmo seed packets (1 each)
specs.organization: Included stake holders for labeling planting spots

record.description: A kid-friendly flower growing kit that lets young gardeners grow zinnias, marigolds, and cosmos from included seed packets. Children decorate a tin planter with paints, including a six-color strip they can mix to make new shades, and use stake holders to organize where each flower goes.

Men's hiking shoe with a suede leather and mesh upper for trail use. A bellows tongue with closed-cell foam helps keep moisture and debris out, while a breathable mesh lining supports airflow. Features a rubber toe cap and a Vibram TC5-plus outsole with 5mm lugs.

specs.interior: Fully lined, zippered organizer pockets, garment restraint

record.description: A lightweight hardside carry-on suitcase in navy with four multi-directional spinner wheels for easy maneuvering. The ABS shell has molded corner guards, and the interior is lined and includes zippered pockets and a garment restraint. Top, bottom, and side grab handles aid lifting, and the telescoping trolley handle retracts when not in use.

specs.care: Hand wash cold; do not bleach; hang or line dry
specs.fit: Plus size line, check size chart before purchase

record.description: A lightweight open front blazer for women with a draped silhouette and a soft, stretchy feel. Suited to office, school, casual outings, and evening events. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry.

A building set for creating forts, dens, and tents indoors or outdoors. Snap-together rods and round connectors let children build castles, tunnels, and rocket-ship shapes, then take them apart again. Draping a sheet over the frame makes a hideaway. The set suits group play and encourages teamwork and imaginative problem solving.

specs.heating: Three temperature settings, peak 131°F in 2-3 minutes

record.description: Heated insoles with a memory foam base and arch support for men and women. A rechargeable battery powers three adjustable heat levels and a display shows remaining charge. Trim the front to fit the heating area to your toes. Washable and sized in three options.

specs.size: 60 mm lens width, 18 mm bridge, 140 mm temple length

record.description: Women's aviator sunglasses with a lightweight metal frame in a gold-tone finish and adjustable nose pads. The polycarbonate lenses carry a UV-protective coating and a gradient brown tint. A soft microfiber pouch is included for storage and lens cleaning.

specs.care: Machine washable
specs.use: Football, soccer, running, yoga and other sports

record.description: Men's compression pants from Defender, designed for football, running, yoga and other outdoor workouts in any weather. The stretchy polyester-spandex blend fits snugly, offers muscle support, and provides sun protection rated UPF 30. Machine washable. Sizing runs tight, so consider sizing up for a looser feel.

A heavyweight men's car coat in a black wool blend. It has a thick twill fabric with a soft, cozy feel for cold weather. The roomy cut runs through the chest and waist, and a button front fastens it closed.

A set of twelve large decorative gift bows in a silver metallic foil finish. Each bow is roughly 4.5 inches across and has a self-adhesive back, so it can be stuck directly onto gift wrap, cards, or packages for a festive touch.

specs.charging: Dual USB, one QC 3.0 port and one 2.4A port
specs.display: LED backlit screen with 7 ambient light colors
specs.microphone: Built-in, supports Siri and Google voice commands

record.description: A compact car FM transmitter that plays music from Bluetooth, USB, or a TF card through your car stereo. It offers hands-free calling with one-key answer, a fast-charging USB port, and a backlit display with selectable ambient light colors.

specs.compatibility: Fits most standard 32 oz jelly jars

record.description: A red wild bird feeder designed to hold about 32 ounces of jelly for orioles. The inverted bottle design keeps jelly fresh, clean and dry, and an internal stirrer dispenses measured portions. The bottle is easy to clean and can be swapped with most standard 32 oz jelly jars.

specs.care: Machine wash warm, gentle, non-chlorine bleach

record.description: A king-size sheet set from Sferra's Grande Hotel Collection, made in Italy from 100% Egyptian cotton percale. Crisp white sheets are framed with colored satin stitching, though the fitted sheet has no embroidery. The set includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases.

Ten white festoon LED bulbs sized 42mm for replacing car interior lights such as dome, map, and trunk or cargo lamps. Each bulb carries sixteen 3528 SMD chips. Rated for long life and designed for plug-and-play installation. If a bulb does not light, rotate it 180 degrees.

A gray boat seat from Millennium Marine, model SW-200, built to mount on most boat pedestals. It measures 18 by 21 by 6 inches, weighs about 8 pounds, and carries up to 400 pounds. The listing includes a three-year warranty.

specs.formula: Ammonia free, paraben free, vegan, PETA accredited

record.description: A deep, cool fuschia hair color that is ready to use with no developer. It is semi-permanent and gradually fades over several weeks. The vegan, ammonia-free formula can also be mixed with other shades or the Pastelizer for custom and softer tones.
A mid-height ankle boot for hiking and outdoor wear, with leather uppers, shock-absorbing cushioning, and rubber lug outsoles for traction on varied terrain. Sized for women, in a dark brown finish.

specs.fabric: UA Microthread, dries faster and resists clinging

record.description: A men's Under Armour cap in Academy Blue with red accents. It has a classic, low-profile fit, a pre-curved visor, and a structured front panel that holds its shape. Foam padding adds comfort, and the Microthread fabric is designed to dry quickly.

A compact 0.7 cubic foot microwave oven in red, made by Daewoo under model KOR07R3ZER. It comes with a turntable to help food heat more evenly. A practical countertop appliance for reheating and cooking everyday meals in a small kitchen.

A handmade flower crown headband in royal blue, designed to be worn as a hair wreath for weddings, festivals, or photo sessions. Its approximately 19 cm diameter suits most head sizes, and its floral styling adds an elegant, eye-catching touch for bridal parties and young girls.

specs.dimensions: 42.5 x 23.6 x 27.56 inches (L x W x H)
specs.features: Cup holder, headphone hook, two speaker/CD holders, rear cable tray

record.description: A Z-shaped gaming desk with a curved carbon fiber surface and a roomy top for a computer, keyboard, and books. Built-in cup holder, headphone hook, speaker holders, and a rear cable tray help keep a setup organized. Rated for up to 280 pounds.

A long-barrel curling iron and wand with a 1-inch barrel and a rotating cool tip for safer handling. It reaches up to 430 degrees and uses a rheostat dial to set the temperature. A heat-resistant mat is included to protect your counter while the iron cools.

specs.construction: Breathable knit with grip injection technology
specs.reinforcement: Seamless reinforcement in critical abrasion areas
specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: Mad Grip F50 Thunderdome impact gloves in large, high-visibility orange. Breathable knit shell with grip injection technology aims to improve handling of both large and small items. Seamless reinforcement in high-wear areas is meant to add durability and help dampen vibration. Machine washable for easy cleaning.

specs.suspension: Front telescopic forks, rear mono shock

record.description: A kids' gas dirt bike with a 50cc two-stroke air-cooled engine and easy pull start. Built for off-road use on wet or dry ground, it has front telescopic forks, a rear mono shock, and disc brakes. The throttle can be restricted for speed control, and the automatic transmission means riders just twist and go.

A portable battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 that adds up to 6000 mAh of backup power. It charges the phone through a manual power button and passes data sync through to a computer. Charging cable not included.

specs.material: Polycarbonate hard shell with clear TPU interior

record.description: A rose gold glitter protective case for the Apple iPhone XR. It pairs a hard outer shell with a clear soft inner layer to guard against drops and shocks. The raised edges help shield the screen and camera lens, and the cutouts leave buttons, ports, and speakers accessible.

specs.closure: Magnetic flip with zipper coin pocket
specs.features: Detachable wrist strap, kickstand fold

record.description: A purple wallet-style flip case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 5G. It holds nine cards plus a zipper coin pocket and two side pockets for cash and ID. A detachable leather wrist strap helps with handling, and a folding line on the back turns the case into a kickstand for hands-free viewing. A magnetic clasp keeps contents secure.

specs.type: Leaf net cover for swimming pool
specs.securing: Tuck under water tubes or use reinforced tie-down loops

record.description: A rectangular mesh net that lies over a winter pool cover to catch falling leaves before they sink and decay. Made from knitted polyethylene, it lifts off easily once trees are bare. Tuck the edges under water tubes or fasten them with the built-in tie-down loops.

Replacement caster wheels for office chairs, sold as a set of five. The blue polyurethane wheels roll quietly over cables and are designed to protect hardwood, laminate, tile, and carpet floors without a chair mat. The standard 7/16 inch stem fits common chair bases.

A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 with 64GB of storage in Space Gray. This US version is locked to AT&T and works only with compatible carriers, so check compatibility first. Battery health was tested. Includes a generic MFi-certified charger and cable; no headphones or SIM card.
An oversized white costume bonnet with a floppy brim, made to complete a costume with an instant touch of Americana. One size suits most teens and adults. Also offered in red and black.

specs.included accessories: Walking foot, non-stick foot, 5 size 16 needles, clearance plate

record.description: A gray Singer sewing machine with a metal frame and 32 built-in stitches, including one-step buttonholes. It has a built-in needle threader and can run up to 1,100 stitches per minute. Comes with heavy-duty accessories such as a walking foot, non-stick foot, and clearance plate for thick seams.

specs.features: Seamless toe closure, arch support, reinforced heel and toe

record.description: A men's large green Stance Chewbacca product with a seamless toe closure, arch support, and reinforced heel and toe areas. Its construction targets comfort and durability in the areas that see the most wear.

specs.item: Color changing gel nail polish set
specs.curing: LED or UV nail lamp required
specs.wear time: Up to 2+ weeks with proper application

record.description: A six-color set of temperature-sensitive gel nail polish that shifts shade as nail temperature changes. Each 7 ml bottle is meant to be cured under an LED lamp and works with a base coat and top coat. Packaged in a gift box, it suits holiday or birthday gifting for DIY salon-style manicures at home.

specs.material: Poly blend webbing with PVC coated S hooks

record.description: A four-piece set of red ratchet tie-down straps for securing cargo on vehicles, boats, and recreational gear. Each strap has a metal ratchet buckle, a hook strap, and a soft loop end, and the set ships with a mesh bag for storage. The PVC coated hooks help protect cargo and vehicle surfaces from scratches.

Set of three double-wall glass espresso cups holding five ounces each. The insulated construction helps keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. Suited to espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and tea, and also works for iced drinks and ice cream.

specs.material: Liquid silicone gel rubber with microfiber lining
specs.features: Raised bezels, wireless charging compatible

record.description: A slim protective case for the iPhone X and iPhone XS, made of soft liquid silicone with a microfiber inner lining. It covers the edges and raised bezels help guard the screen and camera. The case works with wireless charging and wipes clean easily.

specs.bottle size: 22 oz long neck or tall beer bottle
specs.attachment: Buckle and clip for backpack or belt

record.description: A neoprene sleeve that keeps water bottles and long neck bottles cool. Its drawstring top helps it fit a range of bottle sizes. Carry it by the shoulder strap, or clip it to a belt or backpack using the included buckle design. Suited to cycling, hiking, travel, and other outdoor activities.

A set of 100 individually sealed 1 ml plastic syringes, each fitted with a cap to protect the tip. Clear scale marks make measuring and dispensing small liquid amounts straightforward. Suited to essential oils, perfume, inks, lab work, and garden watering. No needles included.

specs.design: Marble pattern, raised lips protect camera

record.description: A marble-patterned protective case for iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020 phones with 4.7-inch screens. The flexible TPU shell has a printed finish and a rotating ring on the back that folds out as a stand for watching videos at different angles. Raised edges guard the camera, and cutouts keep the buttons, ports, and speaker accessible.

specs.material: Metal frame with MDF and wood grain top
specs.assembly: About 20 minutes, tools and instructions included

record.description: A rustic industrial computer desk with a wide wood-grain top for monitors, laptops, and writing. Metal X-shaped legs, a back support mesh, and adjustable feet aim for a steady, sturdy build. Edges are polished, and assembly is quick with included hardware.

specs.finish: Brushed matte outer surface, polished inner face
specs.warranty: Lifetime warranty covering manufacturing defects and sizing

record.description: Men's wedding band from King Will, made of tungsten carbide with a brushed matte outer surface and a polished inner face. Its comfort-fit profile and rose gold line accent pair with a black and silver design. A King Will jewelry box for storage is included, and the brand's lifetime warranty covers manufacturing defects and sizing.

specs.spray settings: Full rainshower, concentrated rinse, combination spray

record.description: Chrome rainshower showerhead from Moen with a wide 8.5-inch spray face. It offers a full rainshower, a concentrated rinse, and a combination spray. The reflective chrome finish suits a range of bathroom styles, and the design is described as easy to install.

specs.care: Machine wash cold; tumble dry low

record.description: A two-piece set of pocketed terry cloth mitts that protect your hands when lifting hot cookware and double as hot pads for counters. Each mitt measures about 8.5 by 7.75 inches. Machine washable in cold water and dryable on low heat.

specs.product type: Bunion corrector splint with toe separator
specs.material: Elastic fabric with medical-grade gel separator
specs.care: Gel separators are reusable and easy to clean

record.description: A beige orthopedic splint designed to be worn on the foot to help hold the big toe in alignment and ease bunion discomfort. Its breathable elastic fabric wraps the foot, and a built-in gel separator sits between the toes. An elastic heel loop helps it stay in place, and it can be worn during the day or overnight.

specs.part type: Front bumper license plate mounting bracket

record.description: A black front bumper bracket for mounting a license plate on select Ford F-150 and Lincoln Mark LT trucks from 2006 to 2008. Molded from heavy duty automotive grade thermoplastic, it comes with the screws needed for installation.

specs.key ingredients: Vitamin C, witch hazel, MSM, vitamin E, glycolic acid

record.description: A 4 oz spray toner that combines vitamin C and witch hazel with vitamin E and glycolic acid. Designed to follow cleansing and prepare the skin for serums and moisturizers, it is aimed at dry, sensitive, combination, and oily skin types.

L-shaped corner desk from AuAg with a large work surface for multiple monitors and a metal X crossbar for stability. Adjustable leg pads help it sit level on uneven floors. Includes an iron hook and a free CPU stand. Vintage wood look suits home offices, dorms, and bedrooms.

A slim keychain organizer that holds up to twenty keys in a compact, lightweight carbon fiber frame. It keeps keys tidy, reduces jingling and pocket snags, and includes a SIM tool and bottle opener. It fits easily in a front pocket, purse, or running belt.

A small carbon-lined pouch with an airtight design meant to keep odors contained, sized at about 11 by 6 inches. It includes a wrist strap and velcro closure and is sized to fit in a backpack or be carried by hand. Intended as a storage option for everyday essentials.

A twin-size weighted blanket meant to rest on top of a bed and provide a gentle, snug pressure. Filled with glass beads inside a seven-layer construction to limit leaking. Cotton outer fabric. Suited to one person and recommended for teens or lighter adults. Not for children under 3. Keep away from the face and head.

specs.care: Dry wash or hand wash, then hang to dry

record.description: A pair of decorative throw pillow covers in soft baby blue, with a sequined face and a satin reverse. Each cover measures about 18 by 18 inches and features a concealed zipper for easy insert changes. Suited to weddings, holidays, and everyday room decor. Hand or dry washing is recommended, then hang to dry.

A sparkly ring set with pear-shaped cubic zirconia stones, suited to bridal, bridesmaid, and engagement occasions. Its classic design pairs with casual or formal outfits, and it makes a thoughtful gift for a partner, friend, or family member.

specs.features: Oven safe, dishwasher safe

record.description: A sturdy stainless steel rack for cooling and baking. Its grid pattern keeps small items like cookies from slipping through while letting air circulate. Sized to fit most standard ovens and sheet pans, it lifts food off grease. The rack can go in the dishwasher for easy cleanup.
A 1 oz bottle of pigmented tattoo ink in black, made in the USA. Formulated to heal true and retain vibrant color, it suits tattoo artists working across all styles and art types.

specs.length: Adjustable, approx. 43-49 inches including snap hooks
specs.use: Replacement cross body purse or handbag strap

record.description: A replacement shoulder strap for cross body bags and purses, made from soft brown synthetic PU leather. It adjusts from roughly 43 to 49 inches, including its snap hooks, and has a double-layer band about 0.7 inch wide with gold-tone metal hardware.

Nighttime sleep aid in tablet form containing doxylamine succinate, supplied as one 80-count bottle with one tablet per dose. Intended to help people fall asleep and stay asleep through the night. The maker describes it as non-habit forming when used as directed.

specs.care: Dishwasher safe

record.description: A set of six stemless champagne flutes holding 12 ounces each, made from clear Tritan plastic that is shatterproof and free of BPA. Suited to prosecco, mimosas, and parties, including family gatherings and kids. Dishwasher safe for repeated washing.

specs.style: Curly, wavy, attached headband with drawstring
specs.included: Afro puff with headwrap, eyelash, hairpin

record.description: A short curly synthetic wig with an attached elastic headband that makes styling quick. Tie up your natural hair, pull the headband on, and tighten the drawstring to secure it. Suited to work, travel, parties, and everyday wear.

A 100-inch projection screen with a wrinkle-free matte PVC surface that is simple to wipe clean. Its bottom-roll design sets up without tools, and the tripod stand adjusts in height and folds into the included carry bag. Suited to movies, meetings, classrooms, and outdoor screenings.
A 10-inch French whisk with stainless steel wires built for mixing batters, sauces, and other preparations in bowls or saucepans. Made in the USA, NSF approved, and safe to clean in the dishwasher.

specs.removal: Removable with no damage or residue

record.description: A blue vinyl decal sticker featuring a lion head design with a Born to be a King theme. The removable vinyl is sized about 3.7 by 5 inches and comes with installation instructions. Made in the USA by JS Artworks.

specs.features: working elevator, spinning lookout, bouncy chair

record.description: A two-story treehouse playset based on the Puppy Dog Pals preschool show, featuring the neighborhood pup Keia. Kids can move a working elevator, spin the lookout, and bounce Keia on the chair, while the flower shower, food and water bowls, brush, and bridge add play. Includes seven pieces, with a 3-inch poseable figure. For ages three and up.

Binder pages with protective sleeves for storing CDs and DVDs in a standard 3 ring binder. Each page holds four discs, two per side, and a non-woven liner helps guard media against scratches, fingerprints, and smudges.
A commercial-style drip coffee brewer from Bunn, model AXIOM-15-3, built for brewing coffee in volume. It runs on 120V, 60Hz, single-phase power. Shipped as one unit and made in the United States.

specs.material: Shell and lining 100% polyester, insulation 100% polyester
specs.pockets: 2 waterproof zipper, 2 hook and loop flap
specs.closure: YKK zipper with double metal button

record.description: Men's red snow pants for skiing and snowboarding, with polyester insulation for warmth and a water-repellent finish with taped seams to help keep out wet weather. Includes two zippered pockets and two hook-and-loop flap pockets for everyday essentials, plus snow gaiters at the boot and an adjustable waist.

specs.packaging: Individual box with photo on front

record.description: A miniature sloth figurine shown on a tree, hand-painted in a folk-art style inspired by American and European traditions. Made from stone resin, it belongs to the Heartwood Creek collection and comes in an individual box.

Wired craft ribbon with a traditional woven plaid pattern in orange, green, and red, with metallic gold stripe accents. The monofilament wire along the edges helps shape loops and bows that hold their form. Suited to fall and Thanksgiving decor, floral arrangements, wreaths, gift wrapping, and DIY projects.

specs.closure: Button down front, cuffs, and collar

record.description: A men's long-sleeve plaid shirt with a classic cut that offers extra room through the shoulders, chest, and body. Extended sleeves and tail add length, and buttons run down the front, cuffs, and collar. A single open pocket sits on the chest.

A right-handed five-string bass guitar from Ibanez in a brown finish. It pairs a maple neck and a spalted maple top over a mahogany body, with a rosewood fretboard marked by white dot inlays and a B15 bridge.

A daily body wash enriched with oat that cleanses away dirt, oil, and bacteria while aiming to leave skin feeling moisturized. Designed for dry, itchy skin and gentle enough for sensitive skin, it is fragrance-free, soap-free, and dye-free.

A one-piece footed romper for babies, designed with a relaxed cut for room to move from playtime to bedtime. Made from organic cotton and described as suitable for sensitive skin, it has a diagonal zip front that makes diaper changes simpler, plus non-slip grips on the feet for steadier little steps.

Compact 18W USB-C wall charger with Power Delivery 3.0 for fast charging iPhone 12 series and other USB Type-C phones and tablets. Features a foldable plug for easy portability at home, in the office, or on the go. Includes built-in safeguards against excessive current, overheating, and overcharging.

specs.size: Large stand 4.5 in tall; 2 taper stands 4 in tall
specs.design: Sculpted double heart with rhinestone accents

record.description: A set of three nickel-plated candle stands with sculpted double-heart designs and rhinestone accents. Includes one larger stand for a 3-inch pillar candle and two taper stands, suited to unity candle lighting or romantic wedding decor.

Men's slip-on driving loafer from Lacoste in black leather. Features a flexible moccasin construction and an embossed crocodile logo. A cushioned foam insole adds comfort and shock absorption for everyday wear.

specs.material: Steel pipe bracket, sponge, wooden legs, linen fabric

record.description: A two-seat convertible loveseat with foldable armrests that open into a sleeper bed. The adjustable backrest offers several reclining angles, and the linen-covered cushions sit on solid wood legs. Suited to apartments, studios, and small living spaces. Assembly is quick.

specs.care: Machine washable

record.description: A men's graphic t-shirt featuring a geisha and flower garden design in burgundy. Made from 100% cotton for a soft feel, it is machine washable and has a tagless neck label for comfort.

specs.included_items: Full bodysuit, wings, gloves, and hat

record.description: A Buzz Lightyear dress-up outfit for babies and toddlers, sized 2T, with a full bodysuit, detachable soft wings, gloves, and a hat. It has a self-stick back closure for easy dressing and glitter details. Padded areas at the waist, knees, and leg cuffs add comfort for play or Halloween.

Reusable stainless steel straws for drinking yerba mate, tea, and cocktails. The flared filter end keeps out chunky leaves while letting liquid through, and a spoon-shaped tip helps scoop out spent mate. Compact enough to carry in a pocket or backpack for drinking on the go.

specs.title: Summer Bridge Activities Workbook, Grades 4 to 5
specs.format: Workbook with flash cards, stickers, and answer key

record.description: A summer workbook that helps students bridge from fourth grade to fifth grade in about 15 minutes a day. Activities cover reading, writing, math, and science, including fractions and multiplication. Extras include stickers, flash cards, and an award certificate to keep learning fun.

specs.use: Indoor plant pots and general storage

record.description: A pair of hand-woven cotton rope baskets in two sizes, one 12 inches and one 10 inches. They can hold indoor plants or serve as tidy storage for toys, towels, crafts, and other household items. Their natural, minimal look suits many decor styles.

A men's dress watch from Bulova with a stainless steel case and black leather-alligator strap. Its tonneau-shaped case measures 44.5mm across and it runs on an analog quartz movement. The mineral crystal is curved, and the watch is rated water resistant to 30 meters for splashes and brief immersion, not swimming.

A neoprene neck strap that keeps sunglasses secured during running, cycling, hiking, fishing, and water activities. It floats, resists water and stains, and is offered in several colors. Test the float capacity with your own frames before using it in water.

specs.features: Built-in handles, open top, stackable
specs.care: Hand wash with soap and water; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A set of four clear plastic bins with built-in handles for keeping desk and office supplies tidy. The open tops and see-through walls make contents easy to spot. Suitable for drawers, shelves, cubbies, and filing cabinets, and useful in other rooms as well. Clean with soap and water.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach, low heat iron

record.description: Two square chenille-blend decorative pillow covers with a soft, textured plush feel. Each 18 by 18 inch cover suits a 20 by 20 inch pillow. Hidden zipper makes insertion easy. Machine washable on a gentle cycle. Mixed cream and black tones suit many sofa and bed styles.

specs.fill: All-natural grain and dried French lavender

record.description: A 20-inch plush soft cord that can be heated in the microwave for soothing warmth. Filled with natural grain and dried French lavender, it is meant for relaxation, comfort at bedtime, and stress relief.

specs.certifications: GREENGUARD Gold, CPSIA, CA-117, ASTM F963
specs.cleaning: Wipe with mild soap and water or bleach-free cleaning wipe

record.description: A 12-piece set of soft foam building blocks designed for toddlers to stack, grip, and arrange. The bright primary colors help little ones learn color recognition while practicing coordination and early building skills. Blocks are easy to wipe clean.

specs.dimensions: 18 in H x 13 in W x 9 in D

record.description: A women's backpack from Vera Bradley built for travel, hiking, and everyday use. Its water-repellent fabric wipes clean, and it includes a padded laptop compartment, a trolley sleeve for rolling luggage, and multiple interior and exterior pockets for organization.

A slim, lightweight protective case for the Apple iPhone 11 Pro Max. Its flexible TPU body and matte surface add grip and a smooth feel, while raised edges and precise cutouts aim to fit the phone closely. It is designed only for the iPhone 11 Pro Max, not the standard iPhone 11 or 11 Pro.
A lightweight long-sleeve sweater for women with a classic, close-but-comfortable cut that allows easy movement. Crew neckline with ribbed trim at the collar, cuffs, and hem for a neat finish.

specs.active ingredient: Iodine 250 mcg from sea kelp (Ascophyllum nodosum)
specs.diet: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten free, soy free, GMO free

record.description: A dietary supplement providing 250 mcg of iodine per capsule, sourced from dried sea kelp grown in the United States. Each bottle holds 60 vegetarian capsules, with no added preservatives or stearates. Iodine is a mineral involved in normal thyroid gland function.

specs.dimensions: 20 x 14 x 7 inch (50 x 35 x 18 cm)
specs.closure: 180-degree zipper with lockable double metal zippers

record.description: A carry-on backpack with an expandable main compartment that adds roughly 10 percent more packing room. It opens fully like a suitcase, has padded hideaway shoulder straps, and includes a sleeve for a 17.3-inch laptop plus pockets for small essentials and an anti-theft back pocket.
Opaque acrylic paint in a 75 ml tube, in a deep mars black shade. It blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. The tube is labeled as meeting ASTM D 4236 safety standards and is non-toxic.
A long, striped Santa hat in red and white for holiday dress-up. It has a faux fur trim and a pom-pom on top, and it is made from soft felt and faux fur for comfortable wear.

A checked upright suitcase with an expandable ABS shell and eight multi-directional spinner wheels for easy maneuvering. Interior includes zippered organization pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint panel. Features a retractable trolley handle and corner guards to help protect the exterior.

A two-pack of men's short sleeve T-shirts in white, sized extra large. Each shirt has a left chest pocket with a small exterior logo, a tagless back neck label, and taped neck and shoulder seams for durability.

A classic-style vanity stool with a padded, cushioned seat and slightly flared wooden legs, suited to a dressing table. Built with MDF and solid wood legs for stability, and the high-density sponge seat is meant for comfortable long sits. Also usable as a dining, lounge, piano, or shoe stool.

specs.storage: Two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets
specs.included: Casters and feet for moveable or stationary use

record.description: A navy kitchen island with a solid wood butcher block top suited to food prep or extra serving space. Two drawers and three cabinets offer storage, and brushed nickel hardware gives it a polished look. Ships with both casters and feet, so you can roll it around as a cart or keep it fixed in place.

A set of 60 permanent markers in assorted bright colors with fine tips. Suited to doodling, coloring, scrapbooking, and marking on paper, plastic, wood, metal, and other smooth surfaces. The quick-drying ink is designed to resist smearing and fading. Labeled non-toxic and suitable for children aged 3 and up.

Men's Superstar sneakers from Golden Goose with a grey suede-look upper and smooth blue leather star accents on the heel tab. Lightweight and breathable with a cushioned rubber sole and a casual, vintage-inspired finish suited to everyday wear.
A men's slip-on sneaker with a breathable mesh upper and no stitched seams. Welded construction and molded underlays are designed to give a supportive, performance-oriented fit for everyday wear.

specs.audio formats: MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV, FLAC (USB playback)

record.description: Marine-ready digital media receiver from Sony with built-in Bluetooth for wireless audio. Its IPx5 water-resistant design suits boat environments, and a front USB port plays MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV and FLAC files. It is prepared for SiriusXM satellite radio and includes 6.5-inch dual cone speakers.

Industrial switching power supply board that converts 100-240V AC input into a 24V DC output rated around 150W. Built on a double-sided PCB for stability, with over-voltage, over-current and short-circuit protection. Bare board format suited to power control systems.

A modern ombre area rug from SAFAVIEH's Adirondack collection, machine-woven for a low-shedding surface. Its stain-resistant synthetic fibers suit busy homes, and regular vacuuming with gentle spot cleaning keeps it looking fresh in living rooms, bedrooms, or offices.

A plush, fluffy throw blanket with a faux fur front and soft sherpa back. Its understated tie-dye pattern adds a stylish touch to a couch, chair, or bed. Suitable for snuggling, layering over a comforter, or staying warm, and skin-friendly for those sensitive to natural fibers.

A women's slide sandal from Ted Baker's Avelini line in a yellow shade the listing calls Magnificent Yellow. Listed in US size 8.5 Regular. The listing gives few further details, so check the product page for materials and care.

A novelty throw pillow for camping fans who like sharing a beer by the campsite. It carries a campfire graphic with white lettering on a multicolor background, printed on both sides. The cover is spun-polyester, the pillow is filled with polyester, and it measures 16 by 16 and is sewn closed.

specs.style: Linear wordmark knit on outside of foot

record.description: A six-pack of men's no-show socks from adidas in a black colorway with Onix marl accents. The lightweight Superlite build is designed for a low, comfortable fit. Moisture-wicking yarn helps keep feet dry, and an adidas wordmark is knit on the outside of the foot.

specs.closure: Elastic ankle strap with heel zipper

record.description: Minimalist black ballet flats with a soft faux suede upper and an elastic ankle strap that holds the shoe snugly. A heel zipper makes them easy to slip on and off. Their neutral look suits casual and semi-formal outfits, and the textured outsole is designed for steady footing on varied surfaces.

specs.mounting: Black hook pre-mounted, ready to hang

record.description: Framed abstract floral canvas wall art with a simple gray and yellow blossom design. Giclee-printed on waterproof canvas and stretched over a pine frame. Arrives with a black hook already mounted, so it is ready to hang in living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, or dining areas.

A full figure underwire bra in ivory from Wacoal's Retro Chic line. Two-part seamed full coverage cups are designed to lift and shape, with a sheer mesh window at the top of each cup. The band and sides are made to lie smooth, and the leotard back completes the look.

Individual eyelash extensions in a hybrid silk and mink blend, offered in several L-series curls and thickness options. Lengths range from 8 to 15 mm, in mixed or single sizes. The lashes are described as soft and black, and they are designed to lift from the strip cleanly without residue or kinks.

specs.transformation: Converts into a backpack in one motion

record.description: A lightweight indoor and outdoor play lounge that converts into a backpack in a single motion. It includes a removable activity bar and canopy, a waterproof base, and a cover that can be machine washed. Weighs under four pounds and is noted for its safety testing and award-winning design.

specs.material: TPU and hard PC shell with silicone inner layer
specs.protection: Shockproof, raised bezel for screen and camera
specs.features: Bottom cutouts with attached dust caps for ports

record.description: A slim, three-layer protective case for iPod Touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation models. It pairs a hard outer shell with a soft inner layer to absorb shocks, while a raised edge helps guard the screen and camera when set face down. Cutouts give access to buttons and ports, and attached dust covers protect the charging port.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild soap and water; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A refillable pump dispenser for liquid soap, dish soap, hand sanitizer, or essential oils. Its round, compact body suits bathroom vanities, small pedestal sinks, and kitchen sinks. The wide opening and removable pump head make refilling simple. Made from frosted plastic that resists rust in humid bathroom conditions.

specs.coverage: Up to 500 sq. ft. per kit, varies with surface porosity

record.description: A self-leveling concrete floor coating for interior surfaces such as garage floors, workshops, and basements. It cures to a high-gloss terrazzo-style finish that resists chipping, chemical spills, and hot tire pickup. Each kit covers up to 500 square feet, with foot traffic allowed in 8 to 10 hours.

specs.battery life: About a month or more between charges
specs.surface: Edge-to-edge glass, nearly 30% larger than previous trackpad
specs.input: Four force sensors for click anywhere and pressure detection

record.description: A wireless trackpad for desktop computers with a rechargeable built-in battery. Its glass surface is larger and lower profile than earlier models, and force sensors let you click anywhere and register differences in pressure. It pairs automatically with a Mac.

specs.material: Natural herbs, resins, woods and oils

record.description: Light vetiver incense with a heavy, woodsy, earthy, and sweet scent, rolled in Vietnam from a blend of herbs, resins, woods, and oils. The pack holds 68 sticks, each 11 inches long, for use at home during meditation, yoga, or worship. The listing describes a low-smoke burn.

specs.cup material: Dotted mesh with stretch lace trim
specs.model fit: Model is 5'9" and wears size XS

record.description: An unlined women's bralette in black with dotted mesh cups and stretch lace trim at the cups, underarms, and underband. Features adjustable double rouleau elastic straps and rose gold tone hardware for an adjustable fit.

A countertop pizza oven that suits frozen, pre-baked, or fresh-dough pizzas. A removable stone helps bake crust evenly and crisp. Upper and lower heating elements work together, and the temperature is adjustable up to roughly 680 degrees Fahrenheit. A preheat function prepares the oven before baking.

specs.type: 3 in 1 ski jacket with detachable liner

record.description: A women's winter jacket that works three ways: wear the full set together, use only the waterproof shell for rain, or wear the insulating liner alone. It has a detachable hood, elastic cuffs, and zip-secured pockets for essentials. Suited to skiing, snowboarding, and hiking in cold, wet, or windy conditions.

specs.feathers: Large faux feathers in black, white, and blue
specs.trim: White marabou trim on the sides

record.description: A deluxe feather headdress for Halloween and costume parties, designed to pair with a Native American style outfit. It features large faux feathers in several colors with white marabou trim along the sides. One size fits most teens and adults, making it a versatile accessory for role play and themed events.

A women's Rolex Datejust, model 179178, with an 18k yellow gold bracelet and bezel and a silver dial. The automatic watch is listed in excellent condition, has been serviced as needed, and is backed by a one-year warranty.

Six pairs of women's crew socks with assorted colorful patterns and prints. The cotton blend offers softness, moisture wicking, and a snug, elastic fit. Suitable for athletic activities as well as everyday casual wear with sneakers, boots, or walking shoes.

specs.product type: 2-in-1 matte lip crayon and lip balm kit

record.description: A two-in-one lip kit pairing a matte lip crayon with a built-in lip balm. The crayon offers buildable color with a pointed tip for lining, while the balm hydrates and can add a glossy shine over the lipstick.

A beige 9-foot half patio umbrella with push button tilt and crank lift, built for shade on balconies, decks, and by the pool. Features a large top vent for airflow and a storage strap. The base stand is sold separately.

A four-pack of Mainstays 3-wick scented candles in a mulled cider fragrance, each housed in a glass jar. Designed to fill a room with warm, spiced aroma for gatherings or everyday relaxation. Store in a cool place.

A lightweight, high-waisted mid-thigh shaper from SPANX designed to smooth the lower stomach. Made from breathable microfiber with a cotton gusset, it can be worn with or without panties to help avoid visible panty lines. Available in regular and plus sizes.

specs.type: Girls' racerback seamless crop cami bralette
specs.care: Machine wash cool, tumble dry low

record.description: A lightweight, stretchy starter bralette for girls with a seamless, tag-free design and a racerback cut. Pads are removable. The four-pack suits daily wear, and the breathable fabric is comfortable for active days.

Waterproof work boot from Timberland PRO built for women, with a 6-inch shaft and an alloy safety toe. Full-grain leather upper with a waterproof membrane, an all-weather outsole, and a footbed with anti-fatigue cushioning for all-day comfort on job sites.

specs.lens coating: HDC multicoating with AquaDura outer lens coating

record.description: A compact, rubber-armored 10x25 binocular built for rugged outdoor use. Its central focus knob allows quick, precise adjustment, and its outer lenses resist water, dirt, and scratches. The sealed housing is waterproof to about 5 meters, and the optics aim to deliver sharp, bright views at distance.

specs.material: PU leather cover, polycarbonate shell, ABS keyboard
specs.s_pen: Built-in S Pen holder; S Pen not included

record.description: A slim protective case with a detachable Bluetooth keyboard for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 10.5 (2018). The keys have spring feedback and the keyboard has a backlight with adjustable brightness. An adjustable stand holds the tablet in landscape mode, and a holder keeps an S Pen handy. The tablet is not included.

Wide-mouthed disposable straws sized for thick drinks like smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. Both ends are smooth and open, and the straws reach the bottom of tall cups. A bright, mixed-color set that suits parties, barbecues, and picnics. Can also be washed and reused or used in craft projects.

A women's lace-up rock climbing and bouldering shoe built for a narrower, higher-instep foot. The leather upper offers some stretch and breathability, the smooth last suits long sessions, and reinforced front edge protection helps the shoe hold its shape.

A box of 25 green letter-size folders with two pockets each and an interior die-cut business card holder. The glossy laminated finish looks polished, and the material resists tearing better than standard paper folders. Suited to presentations, school projects, and client materials.

specs.type: Convertible mittens with flip-open fingerless design
specs.shell: 4-way stretch fabric with partial synthetic leather and silicone palm
specs.features: Magnetic convertible closure, windproof TPU membrane, reflective strips

record.description: Warm convertible gloves that flip from mittens to fingerless gloves using magnets, so fingers stay free for tasks like fishing or using a phone. Insulated with Thinsulate and fleece, with a windproof membrane and silicone palm grip. Reflective strips add visibility in winter darkness. Suited to cold-weather outdoor activities.

specs.pockets: Two button-through welt pockets at rear

record.description: Men's slim-fit dress pants with a flat front and tapered leg, fitted through the hip and thigh and sitting below the waist. Made from smooth, flexible twill polyester for comfortable movement. Includes two rear welt pockets with button closures.

specs.care: Machine wash, up to 30°C/86°F

record.description: A lightweight women's hooded jacket with a faux sheepskin lining for soft, comfortable wear. The fixed hood is lined in echo-lamb and helps block wind and rain. It closes with a double-slider zip and has two pockets with invisible zips. It folds into its own pouch for easy carrying.

specs.care: Machine wash and tumble dry
specs.features: Cushioned soles, non-skid grippers

record.description: A six-pair baby sock set with a mix of cooling mesh and thermal waffle styles for use in any season. Cushioned soles add comfort, and non-skid grippers help reduce slipping. Machine washable and dryer safe.

A sheer organza ribbon with wired edges for shaping bows, wreaths, curls, and floral arrangements. Its subtle sheen suits gift wrapping and holiday decor. The polyester material is described as waterproof and suited to outdoor use.

specs.material: 304 stainless steel strap, zinc-plated bolt/nut, steel gasket
specs.pipe fit: Joins 3.0 inch OD pipe to 3.0 inch ID pipe

record.description: A removable, reusable lap joint exhaust clamp that connects a 3-inch OD pipe to a 3-inch ID pipe without welding. Its stainless steel strap spreads clamping force around the full circumference to help seal joints. Requires enough straight pipe on each side and should not sit close to a bend.

specs.use: Indoor and outdoor floor, furniture, and equipment protection
specs.care: Machine washable for reuse

record.description: A heavy-duty canvas cover for shielding floors, carpets, and furniture during painting or messy projects. Made of cotton canvas, it soaks up paint spills and catches dust and debris for quicker cleanup. Double-stitched seams help resist fraying, and it can be laundered for repeated use.

Clear plastic stemmed cups that look like glassware for serving desserts, appetizers, mousse, or drinks. A practical choice for weddings, parties, and other events. Disposable for easy cleanup, or wash and reuse them.

Field marking paint designed for line striping athletic fields. Formulated for aerosol marking machines in an inverted position, it dries quickly and works with most marking machines thanks to its universal tip.
Full-rim rectangular sunglasses from Gucci in a dark havana plastic frame. Green silver mirror lenses offer 100% UV protection. Non-polarized, with a 57 mm lens width and 145 mm arms.

Versace Eros Pour Femme is a women's eau de parfum in a small 0.17-ounce bottle with a splash-style applicator. It belongs to the Versace Eros fragrance line and offers a small size to sample or carry with you.

A lightweight women's long down jacket with a hood, designed for warmth in winter conditions. Its 650-fill down insulation provides heat, while the water-resistant outer layer and secure hand pockets add practicality. Dual zippers complete the design.

specs.features: Altitude hold, headless mode, GPS positioning, Return-to-Home

record.description: A compact quadcopter drone with altitude hold, headless mode, and GPS tracking with Return-to-Home. Its folding design and replaceable arms make it easy to carry. Includes a remote transmitter, spare protection rings, propellers, and a USB charging cable. Camera is not included in this version.

Reusable silicone ear plugs in three sizes, so you can pick the best fit for sleeping, snoring, or noise protection. Oval shape follows the ear canal, and attached hooks help keep them in place overnight. Washable for repeated use.

A high-rise, A-line maxi denim skirt in light blue, extending to a 35 inch length. It features contrast stitching, a curved waistband, and functional front and back pockets. Suited to work, school, or casual outings across several seasons.

Full-coverage performance leggings for women's workouts and everyday sport. Mid-rise fit with a flat, wide waistband and flatlock stitching for comfort and freedom of movement. Features side stripe detailing in black with blue accents.

specs.features: Embossed, die-cut graphic; holes for hanging

record.description: An oval metal wall sign with a raised, embossed Bar & Shield logo and Harley-Davidson script on its face. Measuring 18 by 10.5 inches, it has holes for hanging in a garage, shop, or other room. A fitting gift for a Harley-Davidson fan.

specs.power: One power per pack, not mixed

record.description: A four-pack of square reading glasses designed for women, with a larger frame and spring hinges for a comfortable fit. Each pair in the set shares the same magnifying power. Suitable for reading at home or in the office. Cleaning guidance advises against paper towels, alcohol, and household soaps to protect the lens coatings.

specs.features: Open slots for audio jack, charger cable and volume buttons

record.description: Slim, lightweight silicone case for iPhone 7 Plus and iPhone 8 Plus featuring a smoke-tinted skeleton graphic. It covers the phone's back and edges, helps guard against scratches and minor bumps, and leaves ports and buttons accessible. Easy to put on and remove.
A pack of eight multi-colored six-strand cotton thread skeins with an over-dyed effect. Each skein holds 8.7 yards, and the set is sold under the DMC Color Variations Holiday name.

A large 85-inch 4K UHD smart TV using QLED quantum dot technology for broad color range and high contrast. Dual LED backlights adjust for detail, Quantum HDR supports expanded color, and the Quantum Processor upscales lower-resolution content to 4K. Alexa is built in, and the slim design suits modern rooms.

specs.use: Promise ring for couples; gift for anniversaries and Valentine's Day
specs.care: Store in box or bag; remove before swimming or showering

record.description: A couple's promise ring from Aooaz with a round inlaid cubic zirconia accent, offered in women's size 6.5 and men's size 10.5. Designed as a symbol of commitment for anniversaries and Valentine's Day. Store it in a box or pouch and take it off before swimming or showering to help keep its finish.

specs.sun protection: Omni-Shade blocks UVA and UVB rays

record.description: A long-sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia's PFG line with a classic cut and a tribal fish graphic. The polyester interlock fabric is built to dry quickly and pull moisture away from the skin, and its tight weave is designed to block UV rays. Suited to time on the water or around a campfire.

A five-pack of men's undershirts in grey and black, sized X-Large. Made from cotton or a cotton-polyester blend, with moisture-wicking fabric and a soft feel. Tag-free design and double-needle hem. Colors may vary within the pack.

A men's smartwatch with a white dial, green hour markers, and a black leather strap that adjusts to fit wrists up to 8 inches. It tracks steps, distance, calories, and sleep, and includes a backlight for reading in the dark. Suited to light swimming, not diving.

A lightweight running shoe for kids with a laceless BOA dial closure for a quick, adjustable fit. The synthetic and mesh upper aims to keep feet comfortable, while the REVlite midsole adds cushioning and the rubber outsole provides grip.

A clipper with an alloy housing and a two-tone black and chrome finish. Its adjustable carbon steel blade moves between 000 and 1 settings and can be zero-gapped. The maker reports it runs cooler and quieter than the Envy Clipper, with less vibration than the Master Clipper.

specs.care: Machine wash with like colors, tumble dry low, do not iron

record.description: A hooded bathrobe for men with a full ankle-length cut, made from cotton with loops on both sides to absorb moisture. It has a wide hood, two patch pockets, and a self-fabric belt. Suitable for after a sauna, gym, pool, or beach visit.

specs.type: Gaming chair with massage lumbar cushion
specs.features: 360-degree swivel, rocking, height-adjustable seat, reclining 90-170 degrees
specs.headrest and lumbar: Detachable headrest pillow and lumbar cushion
specs.assembly: Tools and hardware included, about 20 minutes

record.description: A red racing-style gaming and office chair with a USB-powered massage lumbar cushion. It swivels a full 360 degrees, rocks, and adjusts in height and recline. The headrest and lumbar pillows detach, and the chair ships with hardware for assembly.

A floor-length ball gown in royal blue sequined tulle, with a sweetheart neckline, sleeveless cut, and 3D floral and pearl embellishments. Suited to quinceañera, prom, and formal evening occasions. Made to order; size chart measurements are required before ordering.

specs.care: Pre-shrunk, machine washable
specs.design: Tampa Bay football fans, No Risk It, No Biscuit

record.description: A short-sleeve orange t-shirt with a Tampa Bay football fan graphic reading 'No Risk It, No Biscuit.' Made of 100% cotton, screen printed in the USA, pre-shrunk, and machine washable.

specs.connectivity: USB receiver or Bluetooth low energy
specs.power: 1 x AAA battery, listed life of 12 months

record.description: A wireless laser presentation remote from Logitech that connects through a USB receiver or Bluetooth low energy. It works with Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android, and with common slide software. Its listed range suits medium to large rooms. Buttons can be customized through a companion app. Runs on one AAA battery. The manufacturer has discontinued this model.

Replacement tub spout for Delta faucets, designed to work with Delta pull-out diverter and hand shower setups. Made to original specifications and tested for reliable performance. Chrome finish fits standard 1/2 inch or 3/4 inch pipe.

A two-piece writing set with a stainless steel mechanical pencil and ballpoint pen. The pencil takes 0.7mm HB lead and the pen uses 0.8mm black ink for smooth, accurate lines. A knurled grip supports steady handling, and a soft, quiet retractor suits focused work. Makes a practical gift set.

specs.care: Machine washable, dryer safe
