record.description: A whiskey gift set themed for the New Orleans Saints, packed in a solid oak box. It includes two heavy-bottomed lowball glasses, two sandstone coasters, and six soapstone whiskey stones meant to keep spirits from being watered down.

specs.care: Wash inside out with cold water

record.description: A vintage-style patriotic T-shirt printed with the United States flag. It has a modern, comfortable fit and a cotton blend fabric. Printed in the USA, it suits Fourth of July wear or as a gift for anyone who loves America.

specs.features: Mist spray function, neon light

record.description: A handheld, battery-operated fan with a mist spray mode that is activated by holding the power button. It has three speeds, a 180-degree rotating head, and a foldable design that fits on a backpack or desktop. Runtime varies from about 3.5 to 14 hours depending on use.

specs.connectivity: Bluetooth, FM radio, USB, AUX (3.5mm), TF/SD card

record.description: A single-DIN in-dash car stereo offering Bluetooth hands-free calling, music streaming, and remote control. It plays audio from USB, AUX, and memory cards, and includes an FM tuner with preset storage and multicolor LED lighting. Confirm your vehicle fits a single-DIN opening before buying.

specs.cable: Double-braided nylon, foldable, about 4 inches unfurled
specs.compatibility: MacBook Pro 2016/2017, MacBook Air 2015/2016, Galaxy S8, Chromebook Pixel
specs.charging: Fits side-by-side with original Apple charging cable

record.description: Compact USB-C to HDMI adapter that supports video up to 4K at 60Hz for connecting laptops, tablets, and phones to an external display. Its foldable, nylon-braided cable makes it easy to tuck into a laptop sleeve when traveling. Designed to work alongside Apple charging cables.

A flexible single-face corrugated cardboard roll for wrapping fragile items such as glass and metal parts. Its raised A-flute layer cushions against shocks and resists crushing. The recyclable kraft wrap conforms to many shapes and sizes.

A self-propelled gas lawn mower suited to smaller yards, with a 170cc four-stroke engine, a 20-inch steel deck, and a rear collection bag. It can discharge grass to the side or mulch clippings, and its height adjusts across eight positions to suit different grass lengths.

A wire-free bra from Hanes designed for lightweight comfort. Its feather-light fabric sits close to the skin, while a comfort band helps it stay in place. Flexible foam cups offer shape and support, and the sleek cut is meant to stay virtually invisible under clothing. Available in size 2X.

A reusable lunch bag made from waxed canvas with an insulated lining to help keep food and drinks at their intended temperature. It has a carry handle and a roomy interior for packed lunches, and it wipes clean easily for everyday use at work, school, or outings.

specs.accents: Shimmering patterned fabric on horn and hooves
specs.care: Surface washable

record.description: A plush unicorn toy from Melissa & Doug with a soft white body, vivid purple mane and tail, and shimmering patterned accents on its horn and hooves. Its weighted hooves help it stand steadily, and its outer surface is washable.

A twin-size bedding set in navy made from 100% cotton with a sateen weave for a smooth, soft feel. The set includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with deep pockets, and two pillowcases. Machine washable for easy care.

specs.product type: Cup holder phone mount with wireless car charger
specs.compatibility: iPhone and Samsung Galaxy models listed in title

record.description: A car cup holder phone mount that doubles as a Qi wireless charger. Clamps close automatically when a phone is placed in the holder and open when the quick-release button is pressed. The adjustable aluminum arm suits many phone sizes. Fast charging requires a separately sold QC2.0 or QC3.0 car adapter. Thick cases may prevent charging.

A long-sleeve baby girl's dress with a pleated design and an all-over fair isle print. Made from a cotton and polyester jersey blend, it has a crew neckline and pulls on over the head with an elasticized waist. Sized 5T.

A compact square side table with a lower shelf for extra storage. Its steel tubing frame is sturdy, and the brown wood grain finish wipes clean easily. Simple to assemble, it suits small rooms, bedside spaces, and tight corners.

specs.intended use: Cleaning glass water pipes and rigs
specs.features: Tight seal, odor-stopping storage

record.description: A black set of plugs and caps for cleaning glass water pipes and rigs. Two medium plugs fit male and female joints, and one large plug covers bigger openings. The caps help seal the piece for storage and transport while limiting odor.

A golf swing training aid for men, designed to be used with the right hand. It has a 38-inch length and a red finish. Its grip is meant to position the thumb and index finger to encourage muscle engagement, and its weighted head is intended to support a controlled release motion for improving swing tempo and timing.

specs.material: Fiber-reinforced polycarbonate and stainless steel hardware

record.description: A dual tray for underwater camera setups that lets you attach two lights or flashes at once. It helps reduce shadows and improve stability. Flex arms, grips, and lights clip on and release with a push button, and it fits cameras with a standard 1/4-20 tripod socket.

specs.style: Straight taper with glitter pink heart pattern

record.description: A single clear acrylic ear taper with a pink heart pattern and glitter accents, sized at 1/2 inch (12mm) for stretched ear lobes. Two rubber O-rings are included. Two pieces are needed to make a matching pair.

specs.dimensions: 63 in L x 23.7 in W x 29.5 in H
specs.panel material: E1 standard wood with waterproof, anti-scratch surface

record.description: A spacious 63-inch writing desk for home or office, suited to computers, printers and other equipment. Its square tabletop has a water-resistant, scratch-resistant surface that is easy to wipe clean. The sturdy metal frame is BIFMA certified, and adjustable legs help it sit level on uneven floors.

specs.use: Display in kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet or shelf

record.description: A set of six clear display easels for showing a teacup and saucer. Each stand holds one cup with its saucer set behind it so both stay visible. Suited to collectible dishware displayed in a kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet, or on a shelf. Also a thoughtful gift for a dishware collector.

specs.fits: Men US shoe 5-14; Women US shoe 5.5-15.5

record.description: Eight pairs of black compression socks in a large/extra-large size, suited to men and women. Pressure rated at 15-20 mmHg, aimed at supporting circulation during long days, workouts, travel, or pregnancy. Made from a nylon, polyester, and elastane blend for stretch and breathability.

specs.material: Solid polished brass with wood handle

record.description: A large vintage-style school bell with a solid polished brass body and a wooden handle. It stands about 12 inches tall and 5.5 inches long, suited to both decorative display and functional ringing.

A long sleeve fishing tee for men with built-in UPF 50 sun protection and moisture-wicking fabric that helps keep the wearer cool and dry. Its classic cut suits everyday outings and time on the water.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens with a 0.38 mm tip for smooth, precise writing. The pigment-based ink is designed to be waterproof and fade-resistant, suited to note-taking, calendar marking, and everyday tasks.

specs.material: 300GSM cardboard, plastic window, natural jute twine

record.description: Fourteen black bakery boxes with an openable plastic window, sized for cupcakes, macarons, and cookies. Each box folds together without tools. A jute twine bundle is included for tying and carrying. The blank surface can be decorated for party favors or gift packing.

specs.style: Ripped bib overall shorts with raw cuffed hem

record.description: Women's denim bib overall shorts with distressed details and a raw cuffed hem. Adjustable straps with metal buckles offer a flexible fit. Four pockets add practical storage. Lightweight, soft, and breathable with some stretch, suited to casual outings, travel, and summer wear.

Sparkling stud earrings with princess-cut cubic zirconia stones set in a cushion-shaped halo. Crafted from rhodium-plated sterling silver, they offer a diamond-like shine with a simple, elegant look. Each pair arrives with a drawstring pouch for storage or gifting.

specs.delivery: Register to download forms and instructions
specs.packaging: Details on package; no CD included
specs.review: Content reviewed by attorneys and industry experts

record.description: A downloadable kit for drafting a legally valid will. After registering, you can access state-specific forms and instructions to name beneficiaries, distribute assets, and appoint a guardian for minor children. Includes a preprinted sample form for a rough draft. Intended for use in the United States only.

specs.packaging: Cloth carrying pouch and gift box

record.description: Wooden vehicle puzzles for toddlers aged one to three. Four chunky puzzles show a steamer, airplane, car, and police car. Smooth rounded edges and thick pieces suit small hands, and bright colors support learning colors and hand-eye coordination. Comes with a cloth pouch for storage and a gift box.

A low-profile semi-flush ceiling fan with an integrated LED light, a remote control, and seven blades. It offers three fan speeds, a dimmable light with three color temperatures, and a soft warm-white sleep night light. The white lampshade and black housing suit bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and studies.

A chrome flush mount ceiling fixture with a crystal shade, suited to entryways, hallways, dining rooms and bedrooms. Its 143 K9 crystal balls catch and reflect light when on or off. Dimmable and compatible with E26 bulbs, with LED bulbs recommended for longer service life.

specs.stone_style: Round center stone with micro-pave halo

record.description: A halo engagement ring with a round clear cubic zirconia center stone surrounded by micro-pave stones, set in rhodium-plated sterling silver with a pave band. Sized 7 with a 3mm band, it comes in a leather box and suits engagements, weddings, or anniversary gifts.

specs.compatibility: iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max
specs.card slots: 3 card slots and a cash slot
specs.features: Kickstand, auto wake/sleep, cutouts for buttons, camera, speaker and connector

record.description: A slim two-in-one case that pairs a protective phone shell with a card holder for three cards and some cash. Made from shock-absorbing TPU with a PU leather exterior and soft inner lining. Cutouts give access to ports, buttons and camera. A fold-out stand supports viewing videos or video calls.

specs.window type: Casement, bottom hung, or skylight (not sliding)

record.description: A window seal for portable air conditioners and tumble dryers that fits around an open casement or awning window. The zip closes around the exhaust hose, helping block warm air from flowing back into the room. Made of nylon, it attaches with adhesive hook tape and needs no drilling. It can be removed and stored for the next season.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing
specs.care: Machine washable; do not bleach

record.description: A low-profile drying mat for kitchen counters that soaks up water from dishes, glassware, and produce while its waterproof, slip-resistant backing guards the surface beneath. It can be trimmed with scissors to fit and holds up to repeated washing.

specs.compatibility: Suntek series hunting trail cameras such as HT-002LIG, HC300G, HC300

record.description: Backup solar charging battery pack designed to keep compatible Suntek trail cameras powered in the field. Includes a small solar panel, overload and overdischarge protection, and an IP65 waterproof rating. Mounts to a tree, pole, or camera tripod, and works across a wide temperature range.

specs.features: Dri-Power wicking; side pockets; draw cord waistband

record.description: Men's mesh shorts built for workouts and training. The open mesh fabric promotes airflow, and Dri-Power technology helps wick moisture to keep you feeling cool and dry. An elastic waistband with an internal drawstring lets you adjust the fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

A slim-fitting long-sleeve top in white with a ribbed knit texture and an asymmetrical neckline with a cross-wrap detail. The stretchy blend pulls on easily and pairs well with pants, skirts, or jeans. Sizing runs small, so check the size chart before ordering.

specs.type: Clip-on heel wheels (convert regular shoes to roller skates)
specs.lighting: LEDs in wheels light up when rolling, no batteries needed

record.description: Clip-on heel wheels that turn everyday shoes into roller skates for kids. Built-in LEDs glow as the wheels spin, with no batteries needed. The lightweight design adjusts to fit a range of shoes and includes a rubber strap. Suitable for ages 6 and up.

A single roll of matte white graphic art tape for drawing even, solid lines on charts, crafts, decorations and signs. Its permanent adhesive suits indoor and outdoor use on clean, dry surfaces such as plastic, glass, paper, wood, metal and ceramic.

specs.assembled dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches

record.description: A wooden toddler bed with a PAW Patrol theme, built for children from about 15 months up. Two high side rails help keep little sleepers safe during the move to a big kid bed. The bed is designed for simple assembly and is JPMA certified to meet CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

specs.size: 52 in wide x 84 in long per panel
specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry; do not bleach

record.description: Two sheer window panels with a textured, linen-look finish in a soft ivory tone. Each panel has eight silver grommets at the top for easy hanging. Light and airy, they filter bright sunlight while allowing air flow, suitable for bedrooms or living rooms.

A compact magnetic whiteboard for jotting reminders, lists, and key dates, and it also holds photos and notes with its magnets. The lightweight aluminum frame has a simple look that suits most rooms. It comes with a black marker that has a built-in eraser and can be hung horizontally or vertically.

specs.pack: 12 pack: 5 sandwich bags, 5 snack bags, 2 large bags
specs.closure: Zip lock seal with 2 blue sealing clips
specs.care: Hand wash, air dry; not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher

record.description: A 12-piece set of reusable zip-seal bags made from food-grade PEVA plastic that is free of BPA and PVC. Sized for sandwiches, snacks, and larger portions, they suit lunches, produce, and freezer storage. The transparent bags let you see contents at a glance. Hand wash and air dry, and avoid hot foods.

A seven-piece set of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in an assorted pack, sized 18 months. Each piece has snap fastenings designed to hold up through repeated washing and wear, making them a practical everyday layering option.

specs.key ingredients: Amla fruit extract, white tea extract, hyaluronic acid, plant ceramides

record.description: A vanilla plant-based protein powder meant to support the body's own collagen production. It blends amla fruit extract, amino acids, and plant proteins, and can be mixed into shakes, smoothies, or coffee. The formula is free of dairy, gluten, soy, and artificial flavors and sweeteners.

Six replacement fragrance bulbs in a warm pumpkin scent with notes of sweet butter and vanilla cream. Designed to work with Bath & Body Works Wallflowers plugs and night-lights, these refills are a discontinued scent that can be hard to find.

specs.origin: Eastern Europe (e.g., Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine)
specs.contents: Candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels, and more

record.description: A mixed box of pre-packaged snacks made in Eastern European countries. Contents vary by box and may include candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Each box holds at least eight items, with flavors and varieties chosen at random.

specs.fitment: Universal manual and automatic vehicles without button
specs.package: 1 shifter knob, 3 rubber adapters, 1 hex spanner, 4 metal screws

record.description: A skull-themed gear shift knob for manual and automatic cars, made from resin with an aluminum alloy base. Three adapters fit shift levers from 8mm to 12mm. Installation takes a few minutes with the included spanner and screws. Not suitable for reverse-pull shifters or shifters with a button.

specs.included: 6 packets of water gels for floating

record.description: Faux plastic pearls in ivory with a polished finish and no drilled holes, for smooth-looking decor. Suited to vase fillers, table scatter, and centerpieces for weddings, showers, and anniversaries. Includes six packets of water gels to help the pearls float. Pearls can be reused many times.

specs.included items: Modes Bassinet stroller and SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat
specs.stroller modes: 3 in 1: infant bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller
specs.seat pad cleaning: Spot clean with mild soap and warm water
specs.attachment: Click Connect one-step car seat attachment

record.description: A stroller and infant car seat bundle that grows with your child. The stroller converts from a bassinet for newborns to a car seat carrier and then a toddler stroller, and the toddler seat faces either direction. The infant seat clicks onto the stroller frame in one step.

specs.included: Tray only; flower box sold separately

record.description: A white tray sized to hold a 24-inch flower box. Made from lightweight, fade-resistant plastic, it helps guard decks, patios, or indoor surfaces from soil and water. The flower box is not included, so only the tray comes with this purchase.

specs.dimensions: 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches (L x W x H)
specs.material: Steel with rust resistant PE/plastic coat
specs.mounting: Snug fit arms for cabinet shelves, countertops, or under other shelves

record.description: A medium wire undershelf basket that adds a second storage level inside cabinets, pantries, and shelves. Its snug fit arms hang on a shelf, creating space for small kitchen items such as napkins, spices, and utensils. The steel frame has a rust resistant coating.

specs.chain: 18 in curb link chain (optional, sold with or without)

record.description: A small heart-shaped locket with room for two photos, finished in 24k gold plating. It can be bought with or without an 18-inch curb link chain and arrives in a black velvet pouch, making it a simple gift for women, teens, and girls.

specs.length: 10.5 cm closed, 13 cm with cap attached

record.description: A compact fountain pen with a brass body in classic retro-inspired tones. Its light 21 gram build fits easily in a pocket. The fine gold-plated steel nib offers a smooth, soft writing feel. Each pen is handmade and individually checked in Nuremberg.

Self-fanning volume lash extensions for lash technicians new to hand-made volume sets. The pre-formed fan strip keeps lashes joined at the base so fans form quickly. Available in several colors, with heat-set curls and a treated base adhesive.

A wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks on a distressed wood board, offering a rustic look. Suited to hanging coats, hats, bags, and umbrellas in entryways, kitchens, or bedrooms. Mounting hardware is included for simple installation.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly
specs.intended use: Drying and storing fishing and hunting waders

record.description: A stainless steel chain hanger for drying and storing fishing waders, chest waders, waist waders, hunting waders, and wader boots. Hang waders off the ground in a closet or from a branch to help them dry faster and keep their shape.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket built for layering. The grid-textured bonded fleece outside and soft Sherpa lining inside keep you warm on cool days, and it works well under a shell when temperatures drop further. Two side zip pockets provide secure storage.

specs.dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: A pet stair that helps dogs reach couches and higher beds. Each step has a slight incline to reduce the number of steps needed. Suitable for dogs of many sizes, it has a carpet tread that comes off for easy cleaning.

specs.type: Multifunction pen (black and red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, eraser)
specs.engraving: 25 characters free, deep cut color filled, silver appearance

record.description: A slim multifunction pen that twists between black ballpoint, red ballpoint, and 0.5mm pencil modes. Includes a stylus on the cap for touch screens and a hidden eraser. Satin black finish with chrome accents. Personalized engraving is available, and the pen ships in a gift box.

specs.care: Machine Washable, Pre-Shrunk

record.description: A black short-sleeve football fan t-shirt with a Raiders-themed graphic reading True 'Til The Day I'm Through. Made of cotton, pre-shrunk, and machine washable for everyday wear and game days.

Casual kids' flip-flop sandal with a cushioned EVA footbed that supports the arch. The vegan leather strap has a soft jersey lining to limit rubbing, and the flexible body bends with the foot. A grippy molded outsole helps with traction on varied surfaces.

A white short-sleeve soccer jersey for kids, inspired by the Real Madrid home kit for the 2019-20 season. It has a crewneck, a relaxed body cut, and mesh panels under the arms to help keep wearers cool. The fabric is made from recycled polyester.

An HDTV cable for Sega Saturn consoles, listed as compatible with HDTVs and all Saturn models. It supports 720p output and aims to deliver clear picture and crisp audio. The cable measures 7 feet, and a 6-foot micro cable is included.

specs.fit: Oakley Holbrook, model numbers starting OO9102, 55mm
specs.polarization: Polarized, engraved POLARIZED on left lens

record.description: Replacement lenses in a dark silver mirror finish for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with model numbers starting OO9102. The polarized lenses add UV protection and glare reduction for driving. They are thicker than many replacements and meet the ANSI Z80.3 impact standard. The frame is not included.

specs.material: Fabric straps, nubuck toe post, EVA footbed and midsole, rubber outsole
specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: A women's thong sandal with fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. Its quick-drying molded footbed offers arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar, while the EVA midsole absorbs shock. The rubber outsole is designed to be durable, flexible, and slip-resistant.
A jumbo food and water bowl for extra large dogs, with a heavy base and rubber bottom that resists sliding on tile and linoleum. The bowl is dishwasher safe and comes in assorted colors.

specs.hanging: Poster mounts, clips, push pins, or thumb tacks

record.description: Unframed gloss wall poster featuring LEGO Batman artwork in a grid design. Printed from high-resolution art on FSC-certified paper, it measures about 22 by 34 inches. Officially licensed. Hang it with clips, pins, or poster mounts, or add a frame for a finished look in a bedroom, kids room, or party space.

specs.colors_included: Blue stripe, orange gators, gray stripe

record.description: Sleeveless toddler boys' tank top sold as a three-pack in assorted blue striped, orange gator, and gray striped designs. Features a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. Sized 3T and packaged tag-free.
Large double-wall corrugated gaylord bottom for consolidating multiple-piece shipments and packing bulky, irregularly shaped items. Made from kraft corrugated board. Sold flat in pallet quantities.

specs.dimensions: 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches (H x L x W)
specs.features: USB charging port and earphone hole
specs.closure: Zippered compartments and anti-theft front pocket

record.description: A compact black sling bag made of water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It can be worn across the chest or over one shoulder. Includes two zippered compartments, a front pocket, and an external USB charging port, with a side hole for earphone wires. Suited to travel, cycling, and everyday use.

specs.design: older woman and young girl holding hands
specs.enclosure card: The best gift is time spent with you

record.description: A hand-painted resin figurine showing an older woman and a young girl in cream dresses holding hands on a gray bench. Sculpted to celebrate the bond between grandparent and child, it stands about 5.5 inches tall and sits on a shelf, table, or mantel. Packaged in a fitted box for gift-giving.

specs.blade_style: Replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors

record.description: A heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools, built with large pliers, long blades, and locking features for demanding work. Replaceable wire cutters and spring-action scissors are included, and all tools can be opened with one hand. A nylon sheath and lanyard ring make it easy to carry.

specs.included items: Chef jacket with matching chef hat

record.description: A short-sleeve white chef's coat for women, double-breasted with ten buttons so it can be worn either way. A matching chef hat made from the same cloth comes with it, fastened with Velcro. Choose the size by bust measurement from the size chart.

specs.care: Hand wash with cool water, do not machine wash or dry in sunlight

record.description: Thermal neoprene gloves for diving, snorkeling, kayaking, surfing and other water sports. The 3MM material keeps hands warm, while the textured palm improves grip on small items. An adjustable velcro strap helps seal out sand and debris. Not fully waterproof; designed to be worn with a wetsuit.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Women's junior-cut denim shortalls with a cuffed leg and a short 3-inch inseam. Features multiple pockets, a center-front zipper, and adjustable straps for a customizable fit. Machine washable and suitable for low-heat drying.

specs.ports: 4 x USB 3.0, 1 x USB-C power delivery

record.description: A compact USB-C hub that adds four USB 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and hard drives, with transfers up to 5Gbps. Its USB-C port passes through up to 60W of power to a compatible laptop. Plug and play with no external drivers. The aluminum body has an LED indicator and suits many Mac, Windows and Chromebook devices.

A poster of Oversoul, an artwork by Alex Grey, sold as an official item. It is a museum-quality print measuring 18 by 24 inches. The listing notes that human consciousness serves as a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

A foldable rocking camp chair with a powder-coated steel frame and breathable mesh seat. A low-profile rocker locks in place for steady rocking and reclining. It folds compactly and comes with a carry bag for easy transport and storage.

specs.product type: Replacement batteries for Good Guys doll

record.description: Officially licensed batteries inspired by the Good Guys doll from the Child's Play 2 film. Two D-size cells make a fun accessory for collectors and fans who want to power up their own Good Guys doll display.
